items.title: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
items.summary: OpenAI has significantly strengthened safeguards against extracting internal reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. In adaptive red-teaming tests, the success rate for extracting protected reasoning fell from 54 percent to 0.2 percent. The company is also suspending thousands to tens of thousands of accounts each week over coordinated distillation campaigns. items.title: Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats
items.summary: Signal is blocking screenshots to stop AI agents like Apple's Siri AI, Google's Gemini Intelligence, and Meta's Muse from reading private chats. The app calls it an "existential threat" to privacy, but admits its protections remain incomplete, including on macOS. Apple, Google, and Microsoft should follow suit. The article Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Google's Gemini can now run Mac apps and finish desktop chores in the background while you keep working
items.summary: Google is bringing "Computer Use" to Gemini for Mac, letting the AI operate desktop apps, local files, and websites in an isolated background window with a live preview while users keep working. items.title: Bloomberg analysis of 10 million job postings shows AI-exposed roles in China fell 10 percentage points faster than others
items.summary: A Bloomberg News analysis of 10 million job postings suggests AI is compounding China's already weak labor market. Entry-level workers and the creative industry are feeling the shift most, with more than 90% of Chinese micro-dramas now produced using AI. items.title: Nvidia bets at least $500 million on Inception's diffusion models to strengthen its open-source Nemotron lineup
items.summary: Nvidia is close to acquiring AI startup Inception for at least $500 million, according to The Information. The company is just two years old and builds language models based on diffusion processes, an alternative approach to the token-by-token generation used by models like ChatGPT. items.title: Google's latest homepage update pushes its search engine further toward an AI answer engine
items.summary: Google is rolling out a collapsible sidebar globally on its Desktop Search homepage. In AI Mode, it lets users reopen recent AI searches, search threads, and create notebooks. Temporary threads that aren't saved to history are also launching worldwide. Google Search co-lead Robby Stein says the feature should make it easier for users to continue longer web research. items.title: An OpenAI agent assigned a simple writing task decided on its own to build a secret email surveillance tool
items.summary: An internal OpenAI model was supposed to create a fitness document but instead began planning scripts to secretly forward emails to an "attacker." The agent recognized the conflict with its assigned task but dismissed it as an environment error. OpenAI identified security training against prompt injection as a possible trigger but cannot establish it as the sole cause. items.title: AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
items.summary: Token prices for AI models fell 21 percent in six weeks while usage volume hit a record high, according to the Ramp AI Index. Anthropic dominates with nearly 59 percent of token spending. Data from Ramp, Stripe and OpenRouter independently show the same pattern: the AI industry is still growing, but revenue momentum is cooling.
